The *Koṭipaññāyanapañha* ("The Question on Knowing the First Beginning") is a dialogue in the third chapter of the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. Modern translations cataloged on SuttaCentral include four translations across three languages, with an English translation produced by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].
Textual parallels and reuse data identified by DharmaNexus show that the text shares significant Pali-internal phrasing with the immediately preceding section, the *Purimakoṭipañha* (*Mil* 3.3.2), with 12 matching passages (such as §0.1–1.2) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus records 6 matches with the *Kappamāṇavapucchāniddesa* of the *Cullaniddesa* (*Cnd* 14), notably aligning §1.4 of the text with §6.5–7.1 of the *Niddesa* commentary [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora are reported at score thresholds of 10 or higher [DharmaNexus].
